## About
NTX Roofing Solutions is a roofing contractor on McEwen Rd in Dallas. We inspect roofs, fix what's damaged and replace roofs that need it.
Homeowners have given us a 4.9 rating on Google from 104 reviews. One reviewer, a single mom who was wary of sketchy contractors, said that after the inspection she got pictures of what was wrong and an explanation of her options. Another said his neighbor wished they had used us too.
We're open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday. If something looks off up there, give us a call.

## Services
- Inspections: We look things over and show you what we find. One reviewer got pictures of the problems and an explanation of the options to fix them.
- Roof repairs: From damaged areas to rotted wood, we fix what's wrong. One reviewer asked for a quote on a Wednesday and had our crew at her home on Friday.
- New roofs: When patching won't do, we put on a new roof. One reviewer said she'd recommend us to anyone needing a new roof or other repairs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: One reviewer said we met with her insurance company as part of her roof job. Call us and we can talk through your situation.

Q: Is the roof evaluation free?
A: One reviewer said we did a free evaluation of her roof. Give us a call to ask about yours.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, we're open Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. We're closed Wednesday and Sunday.
